description: This file defines the GenericDateDisplayField class, which is a part of the OrangeHRM project. It extends CombinedDisplayField and manages the mapping of specific date-related display fields for the HRM system, such as employee birthday, license expiry, joined date, and termination date. The class sets and retrieves entity aliases and fields, and provides related DTO class and property information.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayField
classes.description: Handles mapping of specific date display fields for personnel and employment details within the HRM system.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets entity alias and field based on the provided DisplayField's alias.

methods.name: setEntityAlias
methods.description: Sets the internal entity alias used for data retrieval.

methods.name: setField
methods.description: Sets the specific data field associated with the display.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the associated Data Transfer Object class name.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity aliases used for fetching data.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the data fields used for display.
